svg.title: Жим ногами одной ногой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. A single-leg 45-degree sled leg press, side three-quarter view. Athlete sits low on reclined machine seat with upper back and hips contacting pad, hands on fixed handles. Exactly ONE working foot is centered against the slanted sled footplate. The other foot stays clearly off the moving footplate on a stationary support beside the low seat in both phases. Left: working knee bends deeply with sled closer. Right: working leg is nearly straight, sled farther up the guide rails, working sole still against same point on footplate. Keep both legs anatomically clear. No use of the second leg on the moving plate. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
